Commentary.Commentary: That completes our formalities of this game. It's certainly been among the finest Test matches in recent years. Hope you loved our coverage. The two teams will face off in the final Test starting on October 28 in Dhaka. The action will start 0930 IST. Till then, enjoy the week with the ongoing PAK-WI Test and IND-NZ ODI series. Cheers!

BEN STOKES (MAN OF THE MATCH) says that the plan was for him or Woakes to take the new ball this morning. Says that he is pleased with his performance in testing sub-continental conditions but says there is a long time to go with another six matches left in the season. Says that the preparation has been good to adjust to the hot and humid conditions.

ALASTAIR COOK feels that it was a really good Test match. Feels that both teams fought out well and lauds the batsmen of both teams for performing on such a tough track. States that the reverse swing quality of his side is a big boost in such conditions. Says that his plan was to start with pace this morning due to that skill with spin as a back up. Lavishly praises Stokes for the all-rounder's incredible performance with both bat and ball. Feels his spinners did okay and says it's a good learning curve for them with another six matches in Asia left. Ends by saying that Test cricket is the ultimate challenge.

MUSHFIQUR RAHIM says he is proud of his team's performance despite the loss. Feels that the collapse in the first innings was a crucial moment in the game. Also points out at the Stokes-Bairstow stand in the second innings as another deciding factor. Hopes that his team can build on this performance in the next game. Lauds both the debutants Mehedi and Sabbir for making their presence felt. Says that it was a good Test wicket although not unplayable. Ends by saying that Dhaka too may have a similar surface and feels that it's the challenge of sub-continent.

Bangladesh needed 59 more when the tail was exposed. Sabbir's tactics with the lower order seemed strange with him taking every single on offer. It did help to whittle down the deficit but eventually gave England too many opportunities to take wickets. That proved costly as it took them just 3.3 overs today to take the last 2 wickets. Despite the defeat, it's a performance Bangladesh can be proud of.

Shakib was the star in the second innings with the ball for the hosts. The target of 286 seemed huge but Bangladesh's run chase was extremely positive. However, they lost wickets at regular intervals and at 140/5, it seemed over before Sabbir rose to the occasion. He and Rahim put the hosts back on track before the tourists bounced back to rip out wickets. Sabbir continued to fight though with an aggressive knock.

Bangladesh replied strongly through Tamim's fifty with the middle order all getting starts but then had a horrible collapse, losing 6 wickets for just 27 runs to hand the tourists a very handy lead. Stokes and Ali were the standout bowlers. Bangladesh fought back by reducing England to 62/5 before the lower order once again rescued the visitors. Stokes was the hero with Bairstow firing again.

A hard-fought win for England as they go 1-0 up in the 2-match Test series. What a riveting Test match! There was action right from day one when Cook opted to bat with the track taking spin straightaway. Debutant Mehedi's 6-fer was the highlight for the hosts while Ali and Bairstow led a lower-order fightback to get England to 293 which seemed more than competitive.

OUT! Umpire's call! It indeed is the game. Stokes has once again done it for his team. He dishes out a lovely full delivery outside off and gets it to swerve back in sharply. Shafiul takes his front leg forward but has his bat way back as he looks to defend. But he is thudded on the pads, they appeal and umpire Dharmasena raises his finger. Shafiul takes the referral. The impact looks to be outside off but he has his bat hiding behind the front pad, meaning he wasn't offering any shot. Hence the impact can't be an issue here. But is it curling in enough to hit the stumps, even clipping the stumps will do as the umpire has given it out. Hawk Eye confirms it to be clipping off which means the onfield decision will stay as it is. Heartbreak for Bangladesh. ENGLAND WIN BY 22 RUNS! This is also the narrowest margin of defeat for the hosts in terms of runs which shows they fought very hard in this Test match.
Shaiful has been given out lbw. He opts for the review. Is it the game?
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, angling down, Shafiul tries keeping it out in an awkward way but misses.
Shafiul Islam is the last man in. Bangladesh still need 23. England are just one good delivery away. What will Sabbir's tactics be now?

OUT! Gone! The English players jump in joy. A review well taken. Stokes angles in a length ball from around off, skidding in and beating the attempted flick shot by Taijul. He is rapped on the pads, they appeal and the batsmen take a couple of runs. The umpire signals for leg byes and immediately Stokes convinces his skipper to take the DRS. The third umpire starts his job. It's not a no ball first up. Now the replay moves away, it's hitting the batsman in line, no edge involved but where is this heading? Looks to be clipping leg. No, it's in fact hitting the leg stump and Taijul has to go. England on the brink now. They need 1 more wicket, Bangladesh need 23 runs.
Appeal for an lbw. Not given and England take the referral.

Full length ball sliding down the leg side, it's clipped away nicely for a single at deep square leg. He has retained strike, thereby giving England another opportunity to have a go at him. Interesting ploy by Sabbir to agree for a run. 23 more needed.
Hits the yorker mark wide outside off, Islam digs it out back to the bowler.
Good delivery, tailing into the left-hander from outside off, Taijul does well to play it out. He flicks it with the nice use of his wrists and pushes it to backward square leg.
Once again attacking field for Taijul Islam.
Broad further pitches it up and lands it outside off, Sabbir squeezes it out at covers, the fielder is standing a bit deep and they steal a single.
Another solid front foot defense by Sabbir. Very watchful and rightly so!
Fuller and on off, darted in, Sabbir gets behind the line and defends it solidly.
Second new ball is now available. England haven't taken it yet, presumably due to the reverse swing that they got last evening.
Play and a miss! Stokes delivers a length ball outside off, a hint of inward shape there, Taijul stays back, has a nervous push at it but misses as the ball beats the inside edge. Nervy moments!
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Taijul stands back and allows it through.
Full in length and angling down the leg side, Taijul fails to flick and Bairstow does well to stop it with a dive to his left.

FOUR! Not in control but Bangladesh won't mind it at all! Stokes switches to around the wicket and bangs in a short ball on middle, Islam takes the challenge to pull it across the line but the bounce gets big on him and takes his gloves. It balloons over the keeper and speeds down to the fence. Vital runs. 25 more needed!
Stokes offers width outside off, Sabbir pushes at it and runs it down through backward point. He takes a single, signs that he is trusting Taijul to hang in.
Good length ball angling into the batsman, it's around off and straightens a bit, Sabbir defends it off his back foot to short mid-wicket.
Ben Stokes to operate from the other end.
Back of a length ball on off, angling in. Taijul defends it safely off the back foot. Nicely negotiated.
Runs in from around the wicket and slips a full ball down the leg side, Islam tries to flick but misses.
A forward short leg and gully comes into place. Broad has switched his angle too.

Edgy! Broad brings a length ball back into the right-hander from around off, Sabbir tries defending it from the crease, a half-hearted push and it goes off the inside edge to fine leg. A single taken and now Taijul will be on strike for next two balls.

Nicely done! First runs of the morning and big cheer from the crowd. A shade overpitched on this occasion, Sabbir gets forward and pushes it solidly through the gap at covers for a couple of runs. 31 more needed!
Pitches it full again, around off this time, Sabbir gets on the front foot and drives it through the line. Finds the cover fielder.
Starts with a full length ball in the channel outside off, shaping in just a shade, Sabbir gets forward, covers the line and shoulders arms.
Time to get it done! Sabbir Rahman and Taijul Islam are the overnight batsmen. England are beginning the bowling with Stuart Broad. He bowled an excellent spell last evening. Here we go...

It's going to be a tense morning for both teams with the equation gettable to either of them. England have their noses just in front at the moment but need to be right on the money with their bowling as there is no scope for error. Bangladesh's hopes are pinned on the shoulders of debutant Sabbir Rahman. His approach will be interesting with only Taijul and Shafiul left for company. A cracking first hour awaits us. Stay tuned.

Hello and welcome folks for the final day of the first Test match between Bangladesh and England. It's been a very competitive match so far with both teams fighting tooth and nail and now it has boiled down to - 33 runs or 2 wickets! The Bangla Tigers have the opportunity to register a historic win for themselves while the English team would be looking to avoid the embarrassment of losing to a lower-ranked team.
DAY 5, FIRST SESSION...

Batty has been the standout bowler for England while Broad produced a cracking spell late in the day as well. Ali and Rashid did take the wickets but weren't able to respond when they were put under pressure. Nevertheless, England have managed to hang in there. They would back themselves to win at the moment although this could be a very nervy finish. Join us tomorrow at 0930 IST for the climax sequence. Till then, it's goodbye from us.

Despite being on debut, Rahman showed very little nerves as he counterpunched with aplomb to rack up an unbeaten fifty. Just when it seemed like he and Rahim were coasting along, the Bangladeshi skipper departed to Batty before Broad inflicted a double strike to dent the hosts. Sabbir has found an adventurous partner in Taijul and the pair have reduced the required runs down to 33. Still anybody's game and it's set up for a thrilling finale tomorrow morning.

What a day of Test match cricket! It was full of action and even now, we are yet to find which side is on top though England are marginally in front. After mopping up the final two English wickets cheaply, Bangladesh came out for the chase with a refreshingly positive approach on a wearing track. Kayes' counterattack set the tone while Shakib too chipped in. However, it was the stand between Rahim and Sabbir that put England under massive pressure.
Only spin is allowed due to bad light but Cook wants his quicker men to bowl. SO, THAT MEANS IT SHALL BE STUMPS ON DAY 4.
Tossed up outside off, Islam leans into it and blocks it out.
Flatter outside off, punched off the back foot to the covers.
Fuller outside off, Islam leans forward to that one and defends it to cover.

In the air....but safe! Taijul is having fun. Floated off break outside off, he wants to go inside out over cover this time but has skewed it in the air. Goes well over wide mid off as Ali gives chase in vain. Another brace added.
Fuller on middle, defended well off the front foot to the bowler.
Mid on drops back.

FOUR! Taijul has a go! Floated on middle, he heaves it away cleanly over wide mid on. Not an easy shot to play against the turn although this didn't quite spin. All these are handy runs for Bangladesh. Still 35 more needed.
Fuller and outside off, Rahman presses forward to that one and blocks it to the bowler.
Another peach from Broad! Back of a length outside off, shapes away late to beat the outside edge.
Shortish around off, Rahman hangs back to that one and fends it on to the pitch.
Fuller on middle, Rahman works it but straight to mid-wicket.
Well directed bumper! Dug in short around off, angled into Rahman who is squared up totally on the fend.
Length ball outside off, Sabbir looks to steer it but gets a bottom edge on to the pitch.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot.

Tough chance goes down! Taijul continues to live dangerously. Gets an outside edge on the poke to a spinning off break. The edge goes between Root (first slip) and Stokes (gully) with the latter getting a hand but it sneaked through to the deep. Another couple added. 39 more needed.
Goes aerial! Floated on middle, Taijul goes for the lofted stroke but hasn't timed it well. Gets enough on it to clear mid off though. Another brace added.
Fuller on middle and leg, Islam manages to dig it out to short leg.
Gets the edge again! Another off break that fizzes away sharply. Taijul pokes at it but finds the edge. On the bounce to gully.
Floated off break outside off, spins away to take the outside edge. On the bounce to gully.
Gareth Batty comes back on.
Fuller on middle, Rahman bunts it through mid on for a brace. Once again, strange to take the extra run.
Good length angled in on off, Taijul pushes at it but gets a thick inside edge behind square for a single.
Almost a nick! Fuller and outside off, this curves away after pitching as Taijul is beaten on the drive.
Very full on middle, dug out to the leg side by Taijul.
Length ball angled in on middle, blocked firmly from the crease by Islam.
Good length on middle, Rahman gets across and works it to mid-wicket. Again takes single off the first ball. Hmm, strange indeed. Maybe he knows something about Taijul that we don't.
Full and sprayed down the leg side, Taijul misses the flick. Bairstow cannot gather it and the ball goes down to fine leg. No run taken as Sabbir wants the strike back.
Back of a length outside off, jabbed off the back foot to the off side.
Play and a miss! Good length outside off, not much bounce as Taijul is beaten on the poke.
Length ball on middle, better from Islam as he blocks it to short leg by getting right behind the line.
Fuller and on off, nipping in sharply, Taijul pushes it towards short mid-wicket.
Full toss outside off, Rahman flays it to sweeper cover for a single. Strange decision from him to take the single. Taijul is now exposed for five deliveries.
Length ball angled in on middle, Taijul misses the flick and is rapped high on the pads.
Almost another wicket! Length ball outside off, tails in sharply as Taijul is beaten on the inside edge. That wasn't far away from the off pole at all.
Taijul Islam walks in next.

OUT! Broad has another! England are pumped up! Full and tailing in from around off, Rabbi tries to dig it out as the ball goes off the pads to Ballance at short leg. Easy catch and the appeal is given. There was an inside edge on it and even if there wasn't, it would have been out lbw as it was that plumb. Just 2 wickets away are England now, Bangladesh still need 48 more.
Back of a length outside off, Sabbir stays back and pushes it through backward point for a single. Wanted the second but won't get it. England will now get three deliveries at the tailender.
Full and swinging in from middle, Rahman shuffles across to flick but is rapped on the pads. Loud appeal for lbw but turned down. Seemed to be sliding down leg and replays confirm it as well.
Good length outside off, blocked well from the crease.

Oh boy! That was so, so close! Fuller and outside off, tails back in a mile as Rabbi calmly lets it pass. The ball goes past the off stump by a whisker. Kamrul was bowled in similar fashion in the first innings and this time just escaped by the narrowest of margins.
Back of a length on leg stump, Sabbir steps out to heave but gets an inside edge down to fine leg. Gets the single he wanted.
Good ball! Back of a length outside off, nips away a touch very late as Rahman is beaten on the poke.
Shortish outside off, Rahman fends but gets a thick outside edge. There is only first slip in place and the ball goes well past him towards third man. Brisk running fetches Rahman a brace.
Fuller outside off, Rahman drives it towards mid off.

Comedy of errors! Shortish on leg stump, fended off the back foot to short mid-wicket. Rabbi charges down the track for a run but Sabbir is least interested. The tailender goes back  and luckily for him, Stokes who had run across off his followthrough, failed to gather the ball cleanly to have a shy at the bowler's end.
Ben Stokes is back on for another spell. Reverse swing beckons.
Peach to end the over! Length ball outside off, Rabbi looks to push at it and is beaten by the extra bounce.
Debutant Kamrul Islam Rabbi walks in next. Pressure moment for him.

OUT! BROAD STRIKES! England continue to chip away at the wickets. Length ball on off, nips back in sharply to rap Mehedi on the pads. Looked plumb to the naked eye and up goes the umpire's finger straightaway. Mehedi goes for the review. No bat involved, impact in line and it's hitting leg stump according to Hawk Eye. England just three wickets away now. 52 more needed for Bangladesh.
Mehedi was been given out lbw. He opts for the review.
Good length outside off, Hasan chases it but is beaten.
Fuller on middle and off, Hasan manages to jam it towards mid on.
Very full and directed at the stumps, Mehedi does well to dig it out to short mid-wicket.
Back of a length outside off, Hasan gets back to push at it and gets an inside edge on the bounce to short leg.
Maiden Test fifty for Rahman, that too on debut. What a knock so far!

FOUR! WHAT A SHOT! This lad is absolutely on fire. Tossed up ball on off, he skips down the track and makes room to dish out a scorching drive straight down the ground to the fence for a boundary. Incredible stroke! 52 more needed to win.
Flatter on middle, worked away to the leg side.
Darted in around off, Sabbir goes for the sweep but the ball lobs off the boot towards short leg. Huge appeal for lbw but there was an inside edge. Replays confirm it.
Drifting in around leg stump, Mehedi sweeps it to backward square leg.
Full toss outside off, Mehedi reaches out and works it towards mid on.
Flatter outside off, blocked well from the crease.
Shortish outside off, sprung off the surface as Sabbir fends it to the off side.
Length ball outside off, Rahman fails to make contact with the ball.
Short ball on middle, Rahman ducks under the bumper.
Fuller on middle and leg, Rahman goes across to flick it but is struck on the pads.
Good length outside off, Rahman defends it well from the crease.
Fuller on the pads, Rahman goes across and chips it over mid-wicket. Made decent contact and a brace added.
Fuller on middle, Hasan looks to block but is rapped on the pads. Inside edge there!
Mehedi Hasan walks out to bat.

OUT! GONE! Batty is the man for England! What a time to get the breakthrough. Floated off break on off, spins in sharply with extra bounce to take Rahim totally by surprise. He tries to fend but the ball lobs off the gloves towards short leg. Ballance at forward short leg takes a comfortable catch by stretching to his right. A brilliant stand has come to an end. This one really took off from the rough. Still 59 needed and we are into the tail although Mehedi can bat.
Floats it up outside off, Rahim looks to block but gets a bottom edge that goes on the bounce to the keeper.
Fuller on leg stump, Rahman goes across to that one and sweeps it down to fine leg. Three more added to the total.

FOUR! Smart batting! Floated on middle, Sabbir goes for the paddle sweep and helps it away with the turn towards the fine leg fence. Root gave chase but in vain. This is turning out to be a gem from Sabbir.
Short and turning into Rahim, tucked through backward square leg for a single.
Gareth Batty is back on.
Full and outside off, Rahman bunts it straight back to the bowler.
Fuller outside off, pushed firmly towards point.

Four Byes! What's happened there? Very full around off,  almost a yorker as Sabbir tries to dig it out. Huge lbw appeal as the ball flies through to the third man fence. Appeal for lbw but the umpire is unmoved. Long chat between Cook and Broad before the skipper decides to review. Too late though as the stipulated 15 seconds to decide has expired. Replays show that the batsman had been beaten totally, so England got lucky as a review would have been wasted. Four precious byes to the total.
Full and on the pads, Rahim shuffles across and tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
Batty is warming up.
Fuller outside off, Rahim pushes at it but gets an outside edge towards point.

FOUR! Superb shot to release the run drought! Dug in short on off, sits up nicely for Rahim who climbs on it with a pull through mid-wicket. Totally in control and kept it all along the ground as it rocketed to the fence.
Slight excitement! Very short and spinning away, too wide but Rahim manages to reach it with a slice. A bit aerial but in the gap through cover. Single added to the total.
Slider on middle, Rahim stays back and defends watchfully.
Short and spinning away, Sabbir looks to pull and ends up jamming it towards mid-wicket off the bottom half. Single taken.
Loopy leg break spinning away sharply, Sabbir lets it pass.
Fuller on leg stump, dug out towards mid on for a single.
Fuller outside off, Rahman sweeps it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Short ball from Broad and Rahim ducks under the bumper.
Shortish outside off, pushed off the back foot to the covers.
Back of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot towards point.
Length ball outside off, Rahim stays in the crease and is solid in defense.
Good length outside off, blocked well from the crease.
Drinks break. 80 more needed by Bangladesh and this game is heading towards an interesting finish. England in desperate need of a wicket at the moment.
Goes back and punches it to long off for a single.
Skidding down, Rahim tries to sweep but fails to connect.
Rahim defends it from within the crease. That was a googly.
Flighted and outside off, once again left alone.
Tossed up ball outside off, left alone.
Oohhh...that wasn't far away from the stumps! Flatter and shorter around middle, Rahman gets back with the pull shot but it catches the bottom edge and runs behind through his legs for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.
Down the leg side again, Rahim leaves it alone.

DROPPED BY BAIRSTOW! Costly miss. Broad angles in a full length ball on middle and leg, Rahman gets across the stumps with the flick shot and it comes off the inside half of the bat. It flies to the left of the keeper who stretches but drops it. They cross for a single.
Full in length and outside off, Rahman sticks back and defends it to the off side.
Angles in a length ball on off, Rahim gets back to defend but it comes off the inside half of the bat and rolls through square leg for a run.
Broad bowls a full ball from wide of the crease, it lands and moves away, Rahim is committed on the front foot in defense and gets beaten.
Change of gloves for Mushfiqur Rahim. Also, some words of advice coming in from the dressing room.
Full and on middle, swept through square leg for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, Rahim strides forward and defends it off the outer half of the bat.
Drags his length short and bowls it around off, Sabbir goes back and punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Sharp away spin from the batsman, Rahman pushes inside the line and edges it wide of first slip.
Loopy leg spinner landing outside leg and spins away towards off, Rahman goes down to sweep but fails to connect.
A leg break landing on middle, Rahman is opened up in defense as it spins away to beat the outside edge and off stump.
Fullish and outside off, Rahim drives it off his front foot to covers.
Rahim has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Bowls it in the corridor of uncertainty, Rahim leaves it alone. Bairstow collects the ball and quickly releases it to score a direct hit at the striker's end. They appeal but the square leg umpire turns it down. Never moved out of the crease, the replays confirm.
Another watchful leave outside the off stump by the Bangladesh skipper.
Good length delivery in the zone outside off, Rahim shoulders arms.
Full and angling into the batsman, Rahim defends it off his front foot to the off side.
Stuart Broad replaces Woakes in the attack.

Gets back to a short ball and punches it to sweeper cover for a single. 200 up for Bangladesh and the crowd is making a lot of noise. They can sense something special coming here. This partnership has kept them alive in this chase. 86 more needed.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
Wow, a short ball on off, spinning away and doesn't rising much, Rahman tries to pull but misses.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Rahim flat bats it down to long on for one.

Duckett almost made a mess! Short and outside off, Rahim goes back and pulls it against the spin to wide long on. Duckett at deep mid-wicket initially moves to his right but then realizes it's speeding down to his left. Recovers and sprints across to stop the ball. They manage to come back for the second.
Tossed up ball on middle, Sabbir goes back and helps it in the vacant region at mid-wicket for a single.
Movement back into the batsman, Rahim gets an inside edge on the pads as he looks to defend. End of a probing over!
Very full and angling in, a hint of reverse, Rahim drives it off his front foot to the bowler.
Cuts down on his pace and bowls a full ball outside off, it curves back in after landing and Rahim defends it watchfully to short cover.
Fullish and on off, Rahim strides forward and opens the face of the bat to push it towards cover-point.
Full ball on off, Rahim is forward in defense.
Shortish and outside off, Rahim shoulders arms.
Tossed up ball outside off, spinning away, Rahman tries sweeping but misses.
Beauty! Drifting in and landing on middle, Rahman draws forward to defend but it curls away sharply to beat the outside edge.
Catch is the shout, safe! Too full in length on off, Sabbir goes hard at it and tries to hit it through the line but it comes off the outer half of the bat and goes in the air. Falls wide of point.
Fetches a full ball from outside off and sweeps it against the spin to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Gets down on one knee and sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Probably a top spinner around middle and leg, extra bounce, Sabbir fails to flick and is hit on the pads.
Adil Rashid replaces Stokes in the attack. 94 more needed for a win.
Fullish outside off, driven off the front foot but straight to mid off.
Inside edge but safe! Length ball on off, angling in, Rahim looks to defend from the crease but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Attempts a yorker, a slower one but fails to hit the mark, Rahim helps it off his pads to silly mid on.
Gets behind the line of a length delivery and blocks it off his back foot.
Again it's very full and this time Sabbir drives it through the gap at covers for a single.
An overpitched ball on off, it's drilled through the line towards mid off where the fielder makes a half stop. He parries it towards mid on and Sabbir looks for a run. But Rahim sends him back.
Defends it off his back foot to end the over. Sensible batting!
On a length and around off, Rahim defends it off his back foot to the off side.
Good length ball angling down the leg side, Rahim fails to flick and it goes off his hips to fine leg for a couple of leg byes. 50-run stand up!
Length ball angling into the batsman, extra bounce, Rahim goes on the back foot, takes his bottom hand off the handle and defends it watchfully.
Angles in a full ball on off, Rahim blocks it with a straight bat.
Wide! Speedy bouncer down the leg side, Rahim sways away from the line. Called a wide for height!
Edged! Full and outside off, Sabbir goes for a cover drive away from his body and edges it down to third man for a single.
Four leg byes! Woakes loses his radar and bowls a length ball down the leg side. Rahim fails to flick and it clips his thigh pad before running down to the fine leg fence. Target is now under 100!
Hint of inward shape from around off, Rahim defends it off the inside half of the bat to mid-wicket.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. No run.

Shout for an lbw, not given. Woakes spears in a fuller length ball on middle and leg, Rahim falls over to the off side while attempting the flick shot. He fails to middle it and is hit on the pads. They appeal but the umpire remains unmoved. Cook has a chat with his bowler who advises not to take the DRS. Good call, it's missing leg as shown in the replays.
Drops it on a full length outside off, Rahim gets forward and defends it solidly.
Fuller and straighter, worked off the pads to square leg.
Length on off, punched from the back foot to short cover.

Stokes drags his length short and darts it into the batsman, Sabbir fails to connect with his pull shot and is hit on the thigh pad. It loops in the air, the English players get excited but the ball falls in front of the mid-wicket fielder who has run in.
Nearly edges it! Terrific delivery, on a length and outside off, reversing a bit, Sabbir has a push inside the line without any feet movement and misses.
Angles in a full ball on off, Sabbir takes a stride in and drives it to mid off.
Good length ball outside off, Sabbir plays away from his body and gets a bottom edge. It goes on one bounce to point.
Rahim guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Fine delivery, full in length and shaping into the batsman, Rahman gets behind the line and pushes it back to the bowler.
Back of a length ball on off, banged into the surface by Woakes, Rahman gets on his toes and taps it down to backward point.
Full in length and outside off, straightening a bit, Sabbir stays back and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Fullish ball on middle, Rahman whips it through mid-wicket, well placed and he returns for the second run.
On a length and outside off, Rahman plays it down to point.
Stifles appeal for an lbw as Rahman fails to work a length ball off his pads. The umpire shakes his head and the replays detect a faint inside edge. Also, it seemed to have pitched outside leg.
The follow-up delivery is excellent, bowls it on a tempting driving length outside off, Rahim has played enough cricket to sense that and he patiently allows it through to the keeper.
Ouch! Stokes bangs in a shortish ball around off, angling in, Rahim fails to get away from the line, in two minds, play or duck and eventually takes a blow on his body.
A gentle good length delivery in the channel outside off, a hint of away movement, Rahim allows it through to the keeper.
On a length and around off, straightening a touch, Rahim gets back and defends it to the off side.
Arrows in a fullish ball on off, Rahim gets forward with a vertical bat in defense.
Good length ball on middle, Sabbir helps it behind square leg and ambles across for a single.
Ben Stokes to bowl from the other end.
Strides forward to a full ball and defends it to the off side.
Fullish on off, Rahim pushes it down straight to mid on.
On a length and around off, Rahim blocks it from the crease.
Full and shaping in a shade, Rahim gets forward and across to flick it straight towards short mid-wicket.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full and angling in, defended off the pads to the leg side.

Back for the last session. 34 overs are remaining in the day's play and the next couple of hours will decide which way this Test match will head. One gets the feeling that the 30 minutes after the break will be crucial. Chris Woakes to begin proceedings after tea.
DAY 4, THIRD SESSION...

England's bowlers continued to have a mixed session. Batty was the pick of the bowlers after lunch but both Ali and Rashid were inconsistent. Stokes generated sharp reverse swing and troubled the batsmen more often than not. Another 107 runs needed and five wickets remain, the game continues to be in the balance. Another 25-30 runs more and England will start to feel the pressure. Join us in a while for what should be a cracking final session.

Another very even session with the pendulum swinging to and fro. England started well with Batty's double strike to get rid of Mominul and Mahmudullah to leave the hosts reeling. Shakib and Rahim were stitching a partnership before the former fell to Ali for the second time in the game. At 140/5, it seemed like England had jarred the door open but Sabbir's counterattack coupled with Rahim's defiance have denied the tourists further joy.
A bit short and turning away, Rahim chops it to point for a single. THAT SHALL BE TEA ON DAY 4.
Flatter outside off, blocked well off the back foot.

That's gone through! Cannot call it a dropped chance to be fair to Bairstow. Slider from Rashid and it scoots through low. Rahman goes back to push and gets a bottom edge that rebounds off Jonny's pads towards short third man. Single taken.
Well bowled! Loopy leg break outside off, Rahman pushes at it with soft hands. Gets the outside edge but it goes on the bounce to gully.
Full toss and Rahim whips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted on off, Rahim lunges and smothers it to the ground.
Adil Rashid comes back on for the last over before tea.
Shortish outside off, Rahman looks to cut but gets a bottom edge to point.
Fuller and outside off, tailing in, left alone to the keeper.
Length ball outside off, blocked well from the crease.
Good length outside off, Rahman leans forward and defends it.
Length ball outside off, steered down to third man for a single.
Good length outside off, shaping away, Rahim wafts at it but is beaten.
Fuller outside off, Rahman reaches out and defends it well.
Floated outside off, Rahim steps out to whip it to long on for a single.
Floated on off, Rahman reaches out and drills it down to long on for a single.
Flatter outside off, blocked well from the crease.

FOUR! Ali drags it short and sprays it way down the leg side. Horror ball and Rahman rocks back to pull it to the fine leg fence for a boundary. All of a sudden, England are under some pressure with this intent from Sabbir. How long can he sustain this?

SIX! Super shot! Rahman is in some mood, isn't he? Tossed up ball outside off, he just skips down the track and hoists it cleanly over long off for a biggie. Shots like that will put pressure on the bowler, especially when the footwork is so decisive.
Fuller on off, angled in as Rahim bunts it to mid on.
Fuller and tailing in on the pads, Rahman clips it behind square for a single.
Length ball outside off, defended nicely from the crease.
Good length outside off, steered towards point.
Good length outside off, bounces extra off a footmark as Rahman pushes at it. Gets a thick inside edge down to fine leg for a brace.

He's comfortably in! Wonder why they referred this upstairs. Length ball outside off, Sabbir steps out to drive but is beaten. He's way down the track and Bairstow fires a direct hit at the striker's end. Referred upstairs but Rahman was well in.
Appeal for a run out and it's being referred. Sabbir seems to be in.
Loopy off break spinning down leg, Rahim misses the flick. Very good take by Bairstow.
Shorter in length outside off, Rahim stays in the crease and steers it to point.
Fuller outside off, Rahim lunges into it and defends it well.
Drifting in on middle, Rahman uses his feet again and this time bunts it down to long on. Single taken.

SIX! That's been clubbed away! Tossed up off break on middle, Sabbir dances down the track and gets to the pitch of the ball before launching way over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. Good attacking batting this.
Drops it short and well down the leg side, Rahim stays back and pulls it hard to short fine leg for a single.
Moeen Ali is back on from the other end.
Good length outside off, steered towards point.
Beaten! This one tails away after pitching as Sabbir goes for a booming drive. No footwork at all and he is lucky not to get a nick.
Almost chopped on! Length ball outside off, Sabbir is neither forward nor back and pushes at it. Gets a thick inside edge that whizzes past leg stump down to fine leg. Brace added.
Full and veering in from outside off, Sabbir gets across and jams it to short mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, tailing in, Sabbir blocks it off the front foot to cover.
Yorker to start the new spell, Rahman does well to dig it out.
Stuart Broad is back on.

FOUR! Finds the edge but in the gap! Good length angled in from outside off, Rahim pokes at it but with soft hands to ride the bounce. Gets the edge that flies between the two slips and a gully to the third man fence. There was a man in the deep but it went finer.
Length ball outside off, tails back in this time, Rahim goes back to block it.
Shortish on middle, Rahim decides to pull but only manages a bottom edge to the leg side.
Back of a length outside off, shaping away late with bounce and Rahim is beaten on the poke. He seems clueless against the reverse swing right now.
Good length ball on off, angling in, Rahim remains inside the crease and defends it from the upper half of the bat.
Full swinging delivery wide outside off, Rahim chases and pushes it to point.
Rahman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Long hop on middle, Rahim pulls it with the spin to deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! Risky but effective! Flighted full ball around off, Rahim dances down to the pitch of the ball and tries to go big over mid on. But it comes off the inside half of the bat and just clears the fielder. He gives the chase but fails to pull it back.
Gets down on one knee and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
A touch short and on off, hit across the line but straight to short mid-wicket.
Flighted full ball on off, Sabbir defends it with a lunge.
Length ball on off, jags back in sharply to ping the pads. Stifled lbw appeal but that did too much off the deck. Probably a bit high too.
Good length angled in on off, Rahim defends it firmly from the crease.
Short of a length on off, blocked off the back foot to the leg side.
Banged hard into the pitch, this doesn't rise as much as the previous two deliveries. Rahim continues to evade them.
Another short ball and Rahim reacts the same way. Ducks with ease.
Short ball and Rahim watches it well before ducking under it.
Sharp off break turning in from off, Rahman hangs back and blocks it out. Ends a successful over for England.
Sabbir Rahman walks out to bat.

OUT! Cracking ball and Moeen has Shakib again! Trademark off spinner's ball this, fizzing away after pitching as Shakib has a tame poke at it. Extra bounce too on offer and the edge is taken superbly by Bairstow behind the stumps. An easy decision for the umpire and Bangladesh have now lost half their side. Huge wicket this for England as Shakib can be really deadly. He falls to Ali for the second time in the match.
Drifting in on off, Rahim steps out and makes room to drill it to cover for a single.
Drifting in on middle, spinning in as Rahim defends off the back foot.
Slider on the pads, Shakib works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Drifting in from outside off, spins away sharply, Shakib hangs back to flick but the ball goes off the bottom edge on to the track.
Moeen Ali is back on.
Fuller and outside off, tails away a touch as Rahim lets it pass. Stokes generating reverse.
Bye! Short of a length outside off, Shakib chases it due to the width but is beaten by the low bounce. Bairstow couldn't gather it cleanly either. The batsmen sneak a bye.
Fuller on leg stump, Rahim shuffles across and clips it down to fine leg for a single.
Good length angled in from outside off, straightens a bit after pitching. Rahim makes a watchful leave.
Good length angled in around off, Rahim stays back and defends it well.
Dug in short around off, Rahim ducks to let it pass.
Tossed up outside off, Shakib presses forward and smothers it to the ground.
Tossed up on middle, Rahim gets across and chips it a bit uppishly towards mid on. Single taken.
Drifting in from outside off, Shakib taps it to the covers for a single.
Short and spinning in sharply from well outside off, Shakib goes back and uses the depth of the crease to adjust. Steers it through backward point for a couple.
Flighted outside off, fuller in length and Rahim slams the drive to sweeper cover. Single taken.
A bit short and outside off, Shakib rocks back and bunts it to cover for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Rahim gets right behind it and defends.
Good length outside off, Rahim camps back and blocks it out.
Outside off, Rahim isn't interested to play at it.
Keeps it full and outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Good length outside off, Rahim shoulders arms to let it pass.
Fuller outside off, Rahim drives without any footwork but gets an inside edge on to the pads.
Drinks break.
Fuller on off, driven firmly towards mid on.
Drifting in on middle, keeps a bit low but Shakib adjusts well to block it out.
SIX! That's dumped into the stands! Excellent strike! Tossed up nicely by Rashid, Shakib fetches it from well outside off and launches it over long on for a maximum. Hit it well with the spin.
Spinning down, played with the turn to leg gully.
Flighted and on middle, spinning in, Shakib gets back and defends it close to his pads.
Fuller in length outside off, it's driven through extra cover for a brace.
A touch short in length and angling in, Rahim tries working on the leg side but misses. It goes off his body to the leg side.
Back of a length ball on off, angling in, Shakib gets back and runs it down to third man for one.
Good length ball on middle, Shakib defends it off his pads to short mid-wicket.
Stokes goes full this time and induces an outside edge. Moving away, Rahim pushes at it and edges it down to third man for a single.
Once again gets some movement away from the little batsman, Rahim pushes inside the line and misses.
On a good length and outside off, hint of shape, Rahim shoulders arms.
Ben Stokes has been introduced into the attack. Let's see if gets the reverse swing going. 166 more needed for a win.
FOUR! Shot! Full floated ball around off, Shakib gets back and plays a delightful off drive for a glorious boundary.
Quicker one on off, spinning in, Shakib defends it off his back foot.
Turning down the leg side, Shakib fails to flick and is hit on the thigh pad.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Shakib tries to cut but gets beaten as it spins back in a shade to beat the inside edge.
Goes down on one knee and sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Flighted and on middle, spinning away, Rahim gets back and defends it to the off side.
Steps out to the pitch of the ball and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted ball on off, spinning in, Rahim goes back to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Spinning down after landing on middle, Rahim plays it off his pads and it goes on one bounce to short leg.
Walks down to the pitch of the ball and pushes it off the outside half of the bat to mid off.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
Full flighted on off, Rahim defends it off his front foot.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
On middle, worked on the leg side.
Shakib pulls out at the last moment as Rashid's handkerchief falls from the back of his trouser. However, Adil is through his delivery stride and still bowls.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Shakib gets back and slaps it through point for a couple.
Flighted full on off, driven off the front foot to mid off.
Short on off, Rahim goes back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.

Excellent delivery, nearly bowled round the legs. A loopy ball landing outside leg, spinning towards the stumps as Rahim tries playing at it but misses. Luckily it has not spun enough to peg the leg stump back.
Quicker on off, Shakib goes back to cut but ends up mistiming it towards short cover.
Full and on off, spinning away, Shakib reads it well before leaving it for the keeper.
Slower in pace and around off, Shakib hangs back and defends it with the spin to the off side.
Lunges to a full ball and defends it to the off side.
Tossed up ball outside off, turning away, Hasan leaves it alone this time.
Flatter and shorter outside off, spinning away, Shakib tries to cut but misses.
Turning down, Shakib goes back and works it wide of leg gully for a single.
Landing around middle and spinning back in with extra bounce, Shakib goes back inside the crease and somehow keeps it out on the off side.
Floated full on off, Shakib defends it off his front foot.
Shakib has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fires a quicker one down the leg side, Shakib allows it through.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. Two runs added to the total.
Mushfiqur Rahim walks in next with Bangladesh in trouble.

OUT! A loopy full ball around off, spinning in a bit, Mahmudullah gets forward and across to flick it on the leg side but misses and is pinged on the front pad. They appeal and the finger goes up after a delay. Mahmudullah opts for the DRS and the replays show that it's not a no ball, there is no inside edge and the impact is within line. So where the ball is heading now? Ohhhh... once again it's crashing on middle. Batty has his second wicket. Around the wicket angle as worked for him. Bangladesh going off track. 178 needed for a win!
England have taken a review for lbw against Mahmudullah.
Mahmudullah has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Floated full ball on middle, spinning down, Mahmudullah tries to sweep but misses. It goes off his pads to leg gully where the fielder runs to his left and collects the ball. They appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Flatter and shorter on off, Shakib rocks back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Loopy full ball on off, spinning away, Shakib tries to defend but misses.
Flighted and on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Flighted and outside off, Mahmudullah strides forward to defend but it goes off the outside edge past first slip for a couple of runs.
Full floated on off, Mahmudullah gets forward in defense.
A touch flatter and shorter on middle, Mahmudullah gets back in defense.
Tossed up ball on middle, defended off the front foot to the leg side.
Fullish on off, driven off the front foot to covers.
Shakib Al Hasan walks out to bat.

OUT! Flighted full ball around leg, Haque kneels to sweep but misses. It spins away a bit towards off and strikes him on the pads. They appeal as the ball lobs up to second slip. The umpire shakes his head and after having a chat with his bowler and keeper, Cook takes the DRS. The third umpire first checks for the no ball, it's fine. No edge detected on the Ultra Edge. Now the ball tracking shows that it has pitched on leg and the impact is in line with the stumps. Is it spinning away too much to miss the stumps? No is the answer as the ball is crashing on middle. Batty jumps in joy as the umpire reverses his decision. Mominul is out of here and it's another setback for Bangladesh.
Appeal for an lbw! Not given and England take the referral.
Loopy and around off, Haque goes back and defends it with the spin to the off side.
Full flighted on middle, Haque gets forward and defends it to short mid-wicket.
Drifting in and spinning away sharply, Mominul tries to cut but misses.
Tossed up and too full around leg, Mominul fails to middle his sweep shot.
Tossed up and on off, Mahmudullah leans forward and blocks. Lovely over by Rashid!
Big spin away from the batsman, shorter in length, Mahmudullah shapes up for the pull shot but after seeing it's too wide, he leaves it alone. Should have tried to square cut it.
Beautiful delivery, extra flight and lands full on middle, Mahmudullah gets behind the line, covers the turn and pushes it back.
Slower through the air, full and on middle, it's defended off the front foot to the leg side.
Loopy again, on middle and spinning away, Mahmudullah prods forward and jams it down.
Loopy full ball outside off, staying low, Mahmudullah stays back and does well to keep it out.
FOUR! Poor delivery and Batty has been battered! He lets out a full toss on middle, Haque gets down the track and powers it over mid-wicket for a boundary. 100 up for Bangladesh!
Peach of a delivery! Drifting into the batsman and landing around off, Mominul goes back to defend but it spins away to beat the outside edge.

Dropped? Floated ball around leg, spinning down, Mahmudullah goes for the sweep but gloves it behind. Bairstow is a bit late in his reflexes and it goes past his gloves to fine leg. Three runs added to the total.
Identical to the last delivery, didn't spin much though, Haque gets back and hits it through square leg for a single.
Loopy ball landing around leg, spinning towards off a bit, Mominul gets back inside the crease and dead bats it near the surface.
Walks down the track and tries to whip it through mid-wicket. But it spins back in a shade to take the inside edge and speeds past short leg for a single.
Googly around off, fuller in length, Haque gets forward and uses a loose bottom hand to defend it out on the off side.
Flighted and outside off, Mominul goes on the back foot and punches it back to the bowler.
Slower through the air, full and landing around off, Mahmudullah lunges and defends it by opening the face of the bat.
Shorter in length this time, around off, Mahmudullah gets back and punches it to sweeper cover for a couple.
Too full in length again, on middle, Mahmudullah pushes it with the spin to covers.
Tossed up and very full wide outside off, Mahmudullah digs it out back to the bowler.
Floated and full on middle, Mahmudullah sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Spinning in with extra bounce, Mahmudullah stays back to defend but it takes his gloves and dies on the right of the leg gully fielder.
Advances down to the pitch of the ball and flicks it with the spin to short mid-wicket.
Poor length, short and wide outside off, Mominul gets back and slaps it through covers for three runs. Target under 200 now!
Turning down the leg side again, this time Mahmudullah holds his posture inside the crease and eases it wide of leg gully for a single.
Full flighted ball on middle, spinning down, Mahmudullah initially looks to commit on the front foot but then quickly goes back to keep it out towards leg gully.
Gareth Batty to bowl from the other end.
Spinning back into the batsman from around off, Mominul gets back and works it to the right side of the leg gully fielder.
Loopy and around off, once again Haque choose to block it from the crease.
A touch short on this occasion, around middle and spinning down a bit, Mominul goes back and hits it to short leg.
A tossed up leg spinner on off, Haque goes on the back foot in defense.
Gets down on one knee to sweep but misses and it goes off his pads to leg gully.
Full floated ball on middle, Mominul gets forward and defends it off the inside half of the bat to short mid-wicket.

Welcome back. The players are on the field as Bangladesh will resume their chase. 200 needed in five sessions sounds quite straightforward and easy but if you give the equation a tadka (flavor) of the pitch, it becomes a challenging task. No surprise, Adil Rashid to start the session...
DAY 4, SECOND SESSION...

Mahmudullah tried ways to get out but has luckily survived while Mominul seems to be growing in confidence. Ali was once again brilliant but Batty disappointed with hardly any consistency in length. Rashid has started well too and has nabbed the key strike of Kayes. The match is in the balance although with another 200 runs still in the bank, England are still firmly on top. Join us in a while for the second session.

A fast-paced session and it's ended pretty even. Bangladesh polished off the last two England wickets quickly and then started their chase quite well. Tamim fell to Ali but Kayes was the man in supreme touch with fluent shots against spin. It seemed like he would take his team to the break in a strong position but his dismissal has evened out the couple of hours.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot. THAT SHALL BE LUNCH ON DAY 4.
Fuller outside off, steps out to that one and jams it to mid on.
Tossed up around off, Mahmudullah looks to flick but the ball spins back to rap the front pad. Stifled appeal for lbw, turned down.
Drifting in on middle, worked away on the leg side for a single.

Top edge but lands safe! What is Mahmudullah doing here with lunch just a few deliveries away? Goes for a powerful sweep stroke but gets a top edge that just flies over backward square leg. Single taken.
Poor from Mahmudullah but he gets away! Flighted outside off, steps out to play an ugly hoick over mid-wicket. Gets it off the inside half past square leg for a brace.
Moeen Ali to bowl the final over before lunch.
Drifting away on a length around off, blocked firmly from the crease.
Floated on middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot.
Sharp leg break and Mahmudullah dabs it late as the ball goes to slip on the bounce.
Flatter outside off, pushed off the back foot to the off side.
Mahmudullah is in next at number 4.

OUT! Big wicket for England! The dangerous Kayes departs. Floated on middle, he goes for the sweep but gets a top edge off the glove that bobbles over Bairstow. Root moves from first slip and takes the catch to perfection. Timely strike for the tourists and it's the one they wanted too as Imrul was looking in great touch.
Fullish on the pads, worked behind square leg for a single.
Good length outside off, left alone to the keeper.

FOUR! Beautiful stroke! Fuller ball around leg stump again, Kayes picks it up nicely to drop kick it over backward square leg. Finds the fence with ease. He's motoring along at the moment with hardly any trouble barring that one brainfade slog over mid-wicket.
Fuller around leg stump, clipped towards square leg.

Four Leg byes! Strange appeal from Broad! Length ball outside leg, Kayes looks to flick but misses. The ball goes off the pads down the leg side past Bairstow to the ropes. Broad was appealing for lbw, no idea why as both pitching and impact was outside leg.
Fuller on the pads, Haque gets across and clips it down to fine leg for a single.
Stuart Broad comes on to bowl.
Drifting in from around leg stump, Kayes tries the reverse sweep but is struck on the pads. Appeal for lbw but turned down.
Tossed up outside off, Kayes gets forward and blocks it firmly.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot.

First false shot from Kayes! Charges down the track for the big shot but Rashid cleverly shortens the length. Imrul continues with the heave over mid-wicket. Hasn't struck it well at all but is lucky as the ball falls short of the fielder in the deep. Brace added.
Floated fuller outside off, Mominul reaches out and pushes it behind point for a single.
Fuller on middle, Kayes goes across and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Adil Rashid comes on to bowl. It'll be interesting to see how he'll fare with two lefties out there.
Flatter outside off, Haque goes back to cut but gets a bottom edge.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot.

FOUR! Beautiful stroke! Mominul seems to be growing in confidence now. Sees the flighted ball outside off and drives it sweetly through the covers. Another pleasant shot. This lad's batting can make for delicious viewing when he's on song.
Spinning away but too short from Ali. Kayes cuts it away to sweeper cover for a single.
Fired in on leg stump, dug out through backward square leg for a single.
Flatter outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Length ball outside off, hangs back and blocks it out.
Good length outside off, another comfortable leave for Imrul.
Length ball angled in outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Good length outside off, defended well from the crease.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
FOUR! Flashes and flashes hard! Short and outside off, Kayes sees the width and slashes hard at it. Gets a thick slice that flies fine to the third man fence for a boundary.

Drifting in on leg stump, Mominul looks to block but is pinned on the front pad. Appeal for lbw but it didn't straighten enough to convince the umpire. Replays show that it was actually hitting leg stump. Wow! What a miss that is for England! They could have reviewed it but weren't sure. Cannot blame them though.
Fullish around off, defended well off the front foot.
Good stop! Short and spinning away, Haque cuts well to backward point where Broad dives to prevent a certain boundary.
Speared fuller on leg, Mominul clips it but Ballance gets a hand at forward short leg.
Fuller outside off, gets well forward this time and blocks it.
Floated outside off, turns away as Mominul pushes at it. The ball goes off the outside edge on the bounce past slip.
Good length angled in on the pads, tucked through backward square leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, Haque pushes at it and gets another inside edge that crashes into the pads.
Shortish outside off, Kayes glides it down to third man for a single.
Full and on off, Kayes gets across and pushes it towards mid on.

Fuller this time outside off, Mominul pushes at it and gets a thick inside edge that rams on to the pads before rolling to cover. Quick single taken. Stokes almost collided with Duckett while swooping in on the ball. The all-rounder isn't happy as he feels there was a run out chance there.
Play and a miss! Length ball angled in from outside off, Mominul flashes at it but misses as the ball sneaks below the bat.
Chris Woakes comes into the attack.
Flatter ball angled in around off, Kayes pushes at it but gets the outside edge. Flies past gully on the bounce.

FOUR! Lovely stroke! Tossed up gently outside off, spinning away and Kayes lofts it with the turn over the covers. Clean strike and that speeds away to the fence. Excellent shot selection so far from.
Flatter outside off, blocked well off the back foot.
Drifting in from outside off, Kayes tries another sweep but is hit on the ribs. Extra bounce.
Fullish outside off, Kayes lunges forward and blocks it out with a straight bat.
Flatter and short outside off, low bounce as Kayes punches it off the back foot to short cover.
Drifting away outside off, reaches out and blocks it well.
Floated outside off, pushed off the front foot to cover.
Flatter outside off, skids on after pitching as Mominul lets it pass.

FOUR! Fab shot! Not a good ball from Batty as he lands it down the leg side. Mominul responds with a fine paddle sweep to the fine leg fence. First confident stroke from him and this might just calm his nerves.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot.
Floated on a length outside off, extra bounce as Haque is hit on the chest while playing back to it.
Drinks break. Bangladesh started with good intent but the big wicket of Tamim means England have begun well.
Fullish outside off, Kayes gets forward and blocks it well.
And again! Another sharp spinning off break and Kayes is beaten on the poke once more.
Great ball! Floated on middle, turns away sharply to beat the outside edge.

FOUR! Kayes continues to impress! It's a loopy ball and he pulls out the reverse sweep and plays it really well to get it to the deep backward point. He's batting like a man possessed so far. Right approach on a pitch like this.

Dropped! Very tough chance though. Mominul continues to be clueless against the spin. Pokes at the off break and gets a thick edge that brushes Bairstow's gloves. Rebounds over slip to third man for a single.
Drifting in around off, spinning away, Kayes pushes at it with soft hands. The ball runs away off the outside edge past gully for a single.
Edged again! Fuller outside off, Mominul pushes at it but gets the outside edge. Doesn't carry to gully.

FOUR! Very edgy from Mominul! Extra bounce as he goes back to cut. Half-hearted attempt and the top edge flies well over slip and gully to the third man fence. He's off the pair but not convincing at all.
Flatter outside off, pushed off the back foot to mid off. Quick single taken.
Very full around off, Kayes digs it out back to the bowler down the track.
Flatter outside off, Kayes gets across to sweep but is hit on the pads. Impact well outside the line.
Another play and a miss! The off break rips away after pitching to beat Kayes' outside edge.
Floated off break outside off, Mominul pushes at it and is beaten by the away turn.
Mominul Haque is the new man in.

OUT! No doubt about this! Tamim falls and it's a massive breakthrough for England. Moeen once again delivers for his team. Serves a flighted full ball around off, Iqbal gets forward to defend but it skids in to catch the inside edge. The ball lobs off the pads and Ballance takes a fine catch stretching to his right at forward short leg. England draw first blood!

NOT OUT! No outside edge! Floated off spinner on off, Tamim draws forward to defend but seems to have missed it. However, Root reacts to his right from first slip to attempt to catch the ball. It pops out off his hands as he falls down but the ball takes his boot, lobs up and then Joe somehow keeps it under his grasp. They are excited, appeal but umpire Dharmasena shakes his head. Cook wants to take the referral but before that the Sri Lankan umpire consults his partner. Maybe checking if it was cleanly taken. But on his part, Dharmasena seems sure there isn't any outside edge. Cook takes the referral and the replays confirm there is no involvement of bat. Quite a drama!

Appeal for a catch. Umpire Dharmasena consults his partner if it's caught well and gets the answer in yes, it seems. The Sri Lankan however is sure that there is no edge and turns down the appeal. Alastair Cook takes the DRS.
Lunges to defend but gets it off the inside half of the bat through backward square leg. A single taken.
Leans forward to defend but it spins away to beat the outside edge.
Flighted and outside off, left alone.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

In the air... safe! Flighted full ball on middle, Tamim advances down the track to loft it over covers but gets it off the toe end of the bat. The ball balloons in the air, Haseeb Hameed (sub) runs back to attempt for the catch but it falls inches wide of his outstretched hands. A couple of runs taken. Living dangerously, Tamim!
Flatter ball on leg, Tamim gets forward to defend and it goes off the inside edge past leg gully for a couple.
Slower full ball outside off, it's left alone
Very full in length on middle, Iqbal dances down the track and forces it without much timing to mid off.
Loopy full ball on off, Tamim strides forward in defense.
Flatter on off, defended off the back foot.
Kayes has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floated one on off, fuller in length, defended off the front foot.
Extra pace and rev on this one, landing just around off and spinning away, Kayes tries defending off the front foot but misses.
A little short and outside off, Tamim cuts it to point past the diving point fielder for a single.
Quicker one around off, skidding in, Tamim gets back and punches it to the off side.
Ballance comes in at short leg.
Fuller outside off, pushed gently to the covers.
Fuller outside off, another hard sweep from Kayes and gets a brace to fine leg. Very good intent from him so far.
On a length around off, turn and extra bounce but Kayes adjusts well to drop it on to the track with soft hands.
Fuller outside leg, clipped away down to fine leg for a single.
Floated fuller on the pads, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up nicely around off, blocked well off the front foot.
Flattish and outside off, Iqbal prefers defends it from the back foot.
Slow loopy ball on off, it's blocked off the front foot.
Fullish on middle and leg, Tamim tries defending by pressing forward but misses and it goes off his pads to fine leg for a couple of leg byes.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Sharp spin away from the batsman, Tamim gets back and leaves it alone.
Defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shout for an lbw as Kayes fails to connect with his sweep shot. He is hit on the body, they appeal but the umpire remains unmoved. Impact well outside off!
Sliding down the leg side, the batsman fails to flick and it goes off his pads to short fine leg. They appeal and the batsmen cross for a leg bye. Missing leg, hence the appeal wasn't entertained.
Tossed up around middle and off, Tamim draws forward and defends it with a straight bat.
Loopy and on off, it's defended off the front foot.
Flighted on middle, helped towards square leg for a single.
Floated on off, Kayes attempts for an inside-out shot over covers but ends up slicing it over point. A single taken.
Tossed up ball on off, spinning away, Kayes fails to connect with his reverse sweep.
Full and outside off, it's driven through covers for a single.
Flat and full down the leg side, Tamim fails to work it off his pads.
Loopy full ball on middle, spinning away, Tamim tries to defend but gets a leading edge towards point.
Strides forward to a full ball and gets it away off the inside edge to mid-wicket. They cross for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Drifting in and spinning away, Kayes tries defending off the front foot but it goes off the outside edge past second slip for one.
FOUR! Another fine shot by Kayes! He sits down on one knee to a full ball around leg and sweeps it with sweet timing to the deep backward square leg fence.
Draws forward and pushes it gently in the gap on the off side for a run.

FOUR BYES! Tossed up ball outside off, spinning away without much bounce, the batsman leaves it alone and it goes through the keeper's legs for a boundary. It's going to be a big challenge for Jonny to keep on this misbehaving wicket!
Slow loopy ball on middle, drifting in, Kayes drives it through covers for a single.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.

FOUR! Good controlled sweep shot! A flighted full ball around middle and leg, Imrul goes down on one knee and sweeps it firmly through backward square leg for a boundary. Does well to roll his wrists over it!
Flatter and outside off, Tamim pushes it from the back foot and gets it off the leading part of the bat. It rolls wide of backward point and they take a single.
Too full on this occasion, around middle, Kayes flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Straighter one, it skids on from around off, Kayes lunges to defend and gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Great delivery, landing full around off and spinning away sharply, Kayes tries defending but misses. Hit on the pads but spinning and bouncing too much.
Spin from both ends to start with the new ball for England. How unique is that for them? Right decision obviously on this track. Moeen Ali to share the new cherry.

Nearly a wicket! Tamim loses his patience, runs down the track for a big shot but is not to the pitch of the ball. He still goes on with his attempted shot, fails to middle and it goes aerially towards mid on. Falling just short of mid off. Calm down, sir!
Lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Flighted full ball on off, Tamim strides forward and defends.
Extra rev on this, landing around off and spinning away, Tamim gets forward to cover the line and then leaves it.
Loopy ball outside off, Iqbal allows it through to the keeper.
Tossed up ball around off, skidding in, Tamim gets back and defends it down.
